scripts.dev:all: concurrently -n web,api -c blue,green "npm run dev -w apps/web" "npm run dev -w apps/api"
scripts.build: prisma generate && npm run build -w @openagents/core && npm run build -w apps/api && npm run build -w apps/web
scripts.postinstall: node -e "console.log('postinstall: prisma generation runs in build/db scripts')"
